title: CLI manual test checklist
description:
Comprehensive manual test cases:

Systems
- vimm systems (default table, headers aligned)
- vimm systems --no-header (no header row)
- vimm systems --plain (TSV)
- vimm systems --json (JSON schema)
- vimm systems --class console/handheld filters

Search
- vimm search --system N64 --query "*mario*" (default table, latest media title shown)
- vimm search --system N64 --query "*fox*" --region USA (filters non‑USA)
- vimm search --system N64 --query "*fox*" --region all --include-variants all (shows VC/LodgeNet)
- vimm search --class console --query "*sonic*"
- vimm search --no-header
- vimm search --plain / --json
- vimm search --match prefix/contains/regex/glob

Download
- vimm download --id 2754 (single)
- vimm download --system N64 --query "*fox*" (filters applied, latest media title chosen)
- vimm download --system N64 --all --region USA (filtered all)
- vimm download --system N64 --all --region USA --include-variants LodgeNet
- vimm download --system N64 --query "*mario*" --dry-run (output list)
- vimm download --json / --plain outputs
- vimm download --resume true (interrupt/re-run)
- vimm download --max-rps 1 (rate limiting)
- vimm download --concurrency 1 vs 4
- vimm download progress UI (TTY; overall + per-title bars)

Verify
- vimm verify --system N64 --query "*fox*" --output-dir ./roms
- vimm verify --id 2754 --output-dir ./roms
- vimm verify --json / --plain

Error handling
- invalid flags (missing --system/--id, invalid --match, negative limits)
- count-check mismatch handling (--all --count-check --strict-count)

Platform behavior
- Windows/macOS/Linux binary runs;  works

title: Add JSON/plain output formats and completion scripts
description: Implement --json/--plain output and generate shell completions for bash/zsh/fish/powershell.

title: Expand tests for filtering and range/resume logic
description: Plan: 1) Add httptest-based tests for filterSearchResults (latest media title, region/variant filtering, error propagation). 2) Add unit tests for totalFromResponse/parseContentRangeTotal and trimMediaTitle dot-title behavior. 3) Ensure no mocks; use local servers/fixtures.

title: Apply region/variant filters to --all with filtered count-check
description: Plan: 1) Build filter config once (region/include-variants). 2) When --all and filters active, pre-filter entries via ROMPage/Latest media title; set expectedCount to eligible count. 3) Skip system-count comparison when filtered, but still count-check against eligible count after downloads. 4) Ensure confirm prompt uses eligible count. 5) Update SPEC/README.

title: Clarify AltZipped/AltZipped2 semantics
description: Review Vimm media JSON to confirm whether AltZipped/AltZipped2 represent downloadable ZIP variants (and how they are accessed). If valid, update selection/availability logic and decide whether to expose a variant selector flag.
close_reason: Implemented --variant support and confirmed alt parameter via Vimm page JS/HTML.

title: Sanitize download filenames to prevent path traversal
description: Download output names should be sanitized (Content-Disposition and GoodTitle-derived) to prevent path traversal / writing outside output-dir. Use filepath.Base and strip separators before joining.

title: Implement --resume with HTTP Range
description: Use existing .part size to request Range downloads and append when the server supports 206 responses; fall back to full download if Range is ignored.

title: Add test coverage for download/verify pipeline
description: Add tests around downloader retry logic, checksum verification, and count checks once those components land.

title: Stop rate limiter ticker after downloads
description: rateLimiter uses time.Ticker but never stops it; add Stop() and call it when download workers finish to avoid goroutine leaks.

title: Implement downloader, retries, and checksum verification
description: Fetch ROM pages, pick latest revision, download files concurrently with retry/backoff, verify CRC/MD5/SHA1 from Vimm's Lair.txt.

title: Select ROM file by Vimm's Lair.txt when verifying
description: ComputeROMHashesFromZip should hash the ROM filename listed in Vimm's Lair.txt when present, instead of assuming the largest file, to avoid false mismatches in multi-file archives.

title: Scaffold Go CLI
description: Add SPEC.md, Go module skeleton, and CLI command wiring with flag parsing and stub subcommands.
